units.source_text: 我抢纸牌大受赞扬的时候，小学校长说要见见这样一位神童，母亲便带着我到校长府上去拜访。

en.t: When I was greatly praised for winning at card-snatching, the elementary school principal said he wanted to meet such a child prodigy, so my mother took me to visit him at his home.

units.source_text: 那时候，我还上小学，数目也只勉强数到一百，又不认识阿拉伯数字，却能轻易地计算乘法和除法，对鸡兔同笼的算题也能应对如流。

en.t: At that time, I was still in elementary school, could only barely count up to one hundred, and did not even know Arabic numerals, yet I could easily do multiplication and division, and could answer problems about chickens and rabbits in the same cage with perfect fluency.

units.source_text: 在我来说，这是浅显易懂的。

en.t: To me, this was simple and easy to understand.

units.source_text: 我没有列式，也没有运算，随随便便地就把算题给解答了。

en.t: I did not set up equations or do calculations; I just casually solved the problems.

units.source_text: 连简单的地理或历史问题，我也都能答出来。

en.t: I could even answer simple geography or history questions.
